select appr_log_seq.nextval from dual
insert into appr_log( log_id, doc_id, ori_emp_id, act_emp_id, per_emp_id ) values ( #{logId}, #{docId}, #{oriEmpId}, #{actEmpId}, #{perEmpId} )
mapper.select: select l.log_id, l.doc_id, l.created_at, eo.emp_name as oriEmpName, ea.emp_name as actEmpName, ep.emp_name as perEmpName from appr_log l join employee eo on l.ori_emp_id = eo.emp_id join employee ea on l.act_emp_id = ea.emp_id join employee ep on l.per_emp_id = ep.emp_id where l.doc_id = #{docId} order by l.created_at asc
